messages:
Harper V: FYI CivicAI Consortium submitted a request asking for retroactive nonprofit pricing on Q1 usage. They say research grant delay caused them to be billed at standard commercial tiers. Request: full volume-tier adjustment for Jan-Mar and Net60 for invoice INV-2029-0042.
Marta G: Do we have their org type on file? Confirm nonprofit status and grant delay evidence before any credits.
recon-bot: CivicAI profile: <https://partners.redwood.com/orgs/civicai|CivicAI Consortium>  nonprofit EIN verified; grant email attached.
Rohit P: How big is the delta? Need disputed amount and which lines qualify as "research" vs production.
Harper V: Disputed amount $32,500 total. They claim $20,400 should have been billed at academic/nonprofit tier (35% off) so refund request = $7,140. They also ask to convert future invoices to nonprofit tier for the remainder of the grant period (6 months) and push INV-2029-0042 to Net60.
Leah S: Deal Desk checklist: 1) org verification (done), 2) evidence of grant delay (attested doc), 3) business outcome (do we want to support research pipelines?), 4) precedent risk. Thoughts?
Marta G: This is strategic for our academic outreach program; low revenue but high PR/partnership upside. I'm open to a conditional exception.
Rohit P: Proposal: approve one-time retro adjustment of 35% on qualifying lines = $7,140, but cap at $8,000. Condition: grant delay attestation required, legal waiver that this is non-precedent, and Finance GL code ADJ-ACAD-02. For future invoices, allow nonprofit pricing for up to 6 months but require a signed MOU and invoice Net60 only for the current invoice.
legal-bot: Draft waiver required: one-time concession, no precedent, clawback if misuse detected. We can prep language.
Leah S: Approver note: Approved retro credit $7,140 (35% on qualifying research lines), cap $8,000. Conditions: (1) signed grant attestation and MOU for 6-month nonprofit pricing, (2) finance posts GL ADJ-ACAD-02 and issues CM-2029-7783, (3) invoice INV-2029-0042 moved to Net60. Approver: Leah S. :white_check_mark:
Harper V: I'll request the signed MOU and attestation and notify the partner. billing-bot: please reserve credit memo slot and defer payment terms.
billing-bot: Reserved CM-2029-7783 (status: pending), updated INV-2029-0042 to Net60 pending docs.
Rohit P: Once MOU attached, I'll create credit memo and post GL. Will mark in Deal Desk tracker as "academic concession - conditional".
Marta G: Also capture as potential PR case; comms to partner success if they want a joint case study.
Harper V: Notifying CivicAI and requesting signed docs. Closing loop when credit memo posts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
